maddeler.e:
احتشين (form VIII)
# اِحْتَشَيْنَ (iḥtašayna) /iħ.ta.ʃaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اُحْتُشِينَ (uḥtušīna) /uħ.tu.ʃiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# اِحْتَشِينَ (iḥtašīna) /iħ.ta.ʃiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
